metadata_description: Accessibility direction لـ navigation, forms, motion و responsive layouts.
title: product أن remains usable في real conditions
description: Practicora aims لـ keyboard الوصول, readable contrast, responsive layouts و motion أن respects المستخدم preferences.
section_1_description: Interactive controls use visible التركيز states و predictable tab order.
section_2_description: Dense views reorganize لـ smaller screens instead من hiding essential الإجراءات.
section_3_description: Reduced-motion preferences limit decorative movement while preserving useful state changes.
section_4_description: Accessibility هو treated as ongoing product work و should يكون tested مع real المستخدمون و assistive technologies.
